text:
ria: uploaded v2 mocks for Playground streaming UX + prompt shelf insert. looking for quick feedback on interruption semantics, token counter placement, and accessibility. links in comments.

omar: nice work. primary question: what should Stop do vs Try again? users confused in prior tests.

ria: proposal: Stop = halt stream and keep partial text; Try again = restart from same prompt. keyboard: Esc stops, Ctrl/Cmd+R tries again.

kai: perf note: keeping KV cache live for a short window lets Try again be fast. ops can configure window; default 8s. need client-side guard ~300-500ms to prevent accidental double tries.

leigh: a11y: ensure Stop button has aria-label="Stop generation, keep partial output" and Try again shows `aria-live` toast when triggered: "Retry started" or when fast retry unavailable show "Fast retry unavailable  warming model".

ria: copy tweak: change "Tokens used" to "Compute tokens" with tooltip: "Estimated compute tokens billed for this conversation." thoughts?

omar: "Compute tokens" reads clearer for audits. +1.

kai: token counter placement: two options in mock: inline in composer (left of send) or small persistent header badge. I prefer composer for discovery; header badge appears after 4+ turns.

leigh: keyboard flow for prompt insert: make inserts reachable and operable with Enter/Space, announce via aria-live polite: "Prompt inserted: <title>". preserve focus in composer.

ria: micro-interaction: animate a short 140ms highlight on inserted text so users notice. add `preserveCursor` flag to insert API so caret stays where dev expects.

omar: regen/try-again CTA should be secondary outline not primary. users hit regen too often if it's primary. add 3s confirm for consecutive tries to avoid spam.

kai: backend will enforce per-user regen rate limits. client will show cooldown countdown next to Try again and set aria-disabled when active.

leigh: mobile note: avoid tiny counters in the footer. use tap-to-expand modal for token breakdown. also ensure large tap targets for Stop/Try again.

ria: token panel: live update (200ms throttle), click expands breakdown with per-turn rows and CSV export. implement a minimal animation so expansion feels smooth.

omar: also need preserveCursor behavior for paste/inserts; otherwise caret jumps. will add API param in client lib.

ux-bot: Reminder: design review meeting at 1899000300 UTC. React with :thumbsup: to confirm.

ria: final follow-ups: owner=ria, @kai (KV window + debounce), @omar (API flag + cooldown UI), @leigh (a11y copy + keyboard doc). will post final figma and test plan before sync. thanks all!
